overall_summary: The data shows clear outperformance in family-centric emotional content (Maa, Papa, Bhai) getting 77-211 views compared to saturated 'self respect' digital-detox posts which are currently tapering off in viewership (some dropping to single digits). However, the core channel identity is 'Dil Ki Diary' focused on relationships and heartbreak.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about Mother, Father, and Brother (OfHrAp3r1G8, v8krtdmxbPs, m4cgM90y9JU) achieved 77 to 211 views, vastly outperforming romance-based posts.
winning_patterns.action: Allocate a small experiment budget to family/universal emotional bonds while retaining relationship pain core.

winning_patterns.evidence: Self-respect posts tied to concrete phone interactions (e.g., keyboard names, archive folders, status lists) performed decently early on (rwOUYo_hayQ - 41 views, wFimeeP_aVc - 34 views).
winning_patterns.action: Keep hooks grounded in specific, highly relatable physical or digital artifacts.

weak_patterns.evidence: Very recent posts about wallpapers, unfollowing, and profile removals (6KVEZc22kS8, HMyw6blmGOc, cuKSS0gHyt0) received 0-2 views, indicating audience fatigue with repetitive phone-setting hooks.
weak_patterns.action: Pause extremely niche or repetitive phone-deletion hooks and pivot to real-world memory triggers.
